author: NASS
description:
I colorized, fully restored, and added sound design to this rare footage filmed in California in August 1945, during the Victory over Japan Day celebrations in downtown San Diego, with additional scenes from San Francisco. Shot around August 14, 1945, the film documents public gatherings following the announcement of Japan’s surrender, marking the official end of the Second World War. The images capture city streets filled with military personnel and civilians as news of the capitulation spread across the United States, offering a historical record of a pivotal moment that signaled the transition from global conflict to peace.


video Restoration Process:
✔ FPS boosted to 60 frames per second 
✔ Image resolution boosted up to 4K
✔ Improved video sharpness and brightness with my own AviSynth scripts
✔ Colorized only for the ambiance (not historically accurate)
✔sound design added only for the ambiance
✔restoration:(stabilisation,denoise,cleand,deblur) made with my own AviSynth and Vapo
title: San Diego, San Francisco 1945 in color, V-J Day [60fps, Remastered] Sound Design
